declarations.docstring: A binary predicate comparing two linear objects indexed by the same quiver.
A distinguished property of a vertex in a quiver.
A second distinguished property of a vertex in a quiver.
The additive commutative group structure induced on a module over a field.
The natural-number-valued rank assigned to a linear object's component at each vertex.
A component with a basis indexed by a finite range has rank equal to the range size.
Prescribed finite bases on an ordered quiver yield auxiliary data whose total size is the sum of the vertex ranks and whose local values agree with them.
At a vertex satisfying the first distinguished property, its associated auxiliary object is related to every linear object.
At a vertex satisfying the second distinguished property, every linear object is related to its associated auxiliary object.
An auxiliary construction whose elaborated type is unavailable in this interface.
Constructs an auxiliary linear object associated with a chosen vertex of a quiver.
